name: Buenos Aires Ciudad
body: A sitemap of thousands of URLs, framing limited to its origin, and Spanish for Argentina declared. But the page still carries UA-260690656-1, and Google stopped processing Universal Analytics in July 2024.
lesson: Remove the Universal Analytics tags, which collect nothing now, and keep one GA4.
summary: buenosaires.gob.ar scores 76 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 11 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 0 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: f1f8cbc0cf1fff44ed858ee5ec228a5e, TS01107d09. Set on /inicio/.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Universal Analytics, Google Tag Manager appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 800 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
